description: This is an XML source file defining a set of simple methods for handling survey questions and responses within the Ofbiz framework. It includes methods for creating and updating survey questions, creating survey responses, and inline validation of responses.

methods.name: createSurveyQuestion
methods.description: Creates a new survey question, validating its type and required fields, and then persisting it.

methods.name: updateSurveyQuestion
methods.description: Updates an existing survey question with new parameters, performing validation similar to createSurveyQuestion.

methods.name: createSurveyResponse
methods.description: Handles the creation of a survey response, including validation, checking for duplicates, and saving responses along with answers.

methods.name: validateSurveyResponseInline
methods.description: Validates individual survey question responses inline, such as checking for proper format, required fields, and specific data types.

methods.name: processSurveyResponseInline
methods.description: Processes each survey response answer, mapping answers to responses, handling content uploads, and storing answers.
